groups.label: File layout
groups.description: How big new files are, how rows are spread across them, and how they are encoded.

groups.label: Row-level operations
groups.description: How DELETE, UPDATE and MERGE change data: rewrite files or write delete files.

groups.label: Commits and manifests
groups.description: Retry behaviour under concurrent writers and how manifests are merged on commit.

groups.label: Metadata and statistics
groups.description: metadata.json retention and the column statistics that drive file pruning.

groups.label: Retention and GC
groups.description: What snapshot expiry and orphan-file removal keep, and whether they may delete at all.

groups.label: Format and identity
groups.description: Table format version and descriptive metadata.

settings.label: Target data file size
settings.summary: The size writers aim for when they roll over to a new data file. The main lever against small files.
settings.takes_effect: Future writes only. Existing files change only when they are next compacted.
settings.reversible: Yes. A metadata-only commit; set it back at any time.
settings.recommendation_reason: Matches the 256 MiB Cryo compacts toward under preset nightly-standard. A smaller write target leaves new files below that size, so every run compacts them again.

risk_directions.label: Lower
risk_directions.detail: New files would be smaller than the 256 MiB Cryo compacts toward under preset nightly-standard, so they count as small and get compacted again.

engine_notes.note: Honoured from Trino 482 (table property target_max_file_size). Before 482 Trino ignores it and uses the catalog's iceberg.target-max-file-size (default 1 GB).
Default target for rewrite_data_files. Spark writes cannot exceed one task's output, so AQE advisory partition size must be at least this large.
Default rolling-file target unless the job overrides it.
Cryo's Spark and native compactions set this to the preset target after every optimize, so a different value is reset on the next run.

settings.label: Target delete file size
settings.summary: Target size for position and equality delete files written by merge-on-read.
settings.takes_effect: Future writes and compactions only. Existing files keep their old layout.
settings.reversible: Yes. A metadata-only commit; set it back at any time.

engine_notes.note: Default target for rewrite_position_delete_files.
Not read by Trino.

settings.label: Write distribution
settings.summary: How rows are shuffled before writing. hash groups rows by partition so each partition gets few, large files; range also orders by the sort key; none writes whatever each task holds.
settings.takes_effect: Future writes and compactions only. Existing files keep their old layout.
settings.reversible: Yes. A metadata-only commit; set it back at any time.
settings.recommendation_reason: Partitioned table without an explicit shuffle. hash groups each partition's rows into one writer, so every engine (Flink included) writes fewer, larger files.

risk_directions.label: Set to none
risk_directions.detail: Without a shuffle, every writer task opens a file per partition it touches, which multiplies small files on a partitioned table.

engine_notes.note: When unset, Spark requests hash since Iceberg 1.2, or range if the table has a sort order.
When unset, Flink does not shuffle (none).
Not read by Trino; Trino has its own writer scaling.
Cryo's Spark and native compactions set this to hash after every optimize.

settings.label: Data file format
settings.summary: File format for new data files.
settings.takes_effect: Future writes only. Existing files stay in their format until compacted, so the table holds mixed formats for a while.
settings.reversible: Yes. A metadata-only commit; set it back at any time.
settings.recommendation_reason: Cryo's bloom-filter, row-group and column-statistics analysis only reads Parquet.

risk_directions.label: Set to orc
risk_directions.detail: The table will hold mixed formats until compacted, and Cryo's bloom-filter and row-group analysis only reads Parquet.

risk_directions.label: Set to avro
risk_directions.detail: The table will hold mixed formats until compacted, and Cryo's bloom-filter and row-group analysis only reads Parquet.

engine_notes.note: Trino table property format.
Cryo's bloom-filter, row-group and column-statistics analysis reads Parquet.

settings.label: Parquet compression
settings.summary: Compression codec for new Parquet data files.
settings.takes_effect: Future writes only. Existing files change only when they are next compacted.
settings.reversible: Yes. A metadata-only commit; set it back at any time.
settings.default_label: zstd for tables created by Iceberg 1.4+; older tables fall back to gzip
settings.recommendation_reason: Set explicitly, so every engine writes the same codec.

risk_directions.label: Set to uncompressed
risk_directions.detail: Uncompressed Parquet typically takes several times the storage.

engine_notes.note: Trino table property compression_codec (477+); new Trino tables get the catalog's iceberg.compression-codec.

settings.label: Parquet row group size
settings.summary: Target size of a Parquet row group, the unit readers skip using min/max statistics.
settings.takes_effect: Future writes only. Existing files change only when they are next compacted.
settings.reversible: Yes. A metadata-only commit; set it back at any time.

engine_notes.note: Honoured from Trino 482 (parquet_writer_row_group_size); earlier versions use the catalog's parquet.writer.row-group-size.

settings.label: Parquet bloom filter columns
settings.summary: Columns that get a Parquet bloom filter, so equality lookups on high-cardinality values skip row groups. Stored as one write.parquet.bloom-filter-enabled.column.<c> property per column.
settings.takes_effect: Future writes only. Existing files change only when they are next compacted.
settings.reversible: Yes. A metadata-only commit; set it back at any time.

engine_notes.note: Trino table property parquet_bloom_filter_columns (469+).
Written by Spark Parquet writers; each filter adds up to 1 MB per row group.

settings.label: Object-storage file layout
settings.summary: Adds a hash component to new data file paths so writes spread across S3 key prefixes instead of throttling on one.
settings.takes_effect: New files only. Existing file paths never change.
settings.reversible: Yes. A metadata-only commit; set it back at any time.

engine_notes.note: Trino table property object_store_layout_enabled.

settings.label: Data file location
settings.summary: Base location for new data files. Defaults to the table location plus /data.
settings.takes_effect: New files only. Existing files are not moved.
settings.reversible: Only for new files; files already written there stay there.
settings.read_only_reason: Orphan-file removal lists files under the table location. Moving new data elsewhere changes what that scan sees, so change it deliberately with engine DDL.

settings.label: DELETE mode
settings.summary: copy-on-write rewrites every data file a DELETE touches; merge-on-read writes small delete files that readers apply and compaction later folds in.
settings.takes_effect: The next DELETE statement.
settings.reversible: Yes. A metadata-only commit; set it back at any time.
settings.note: No recommendation: merge-on-read suits frequent small updates, copy-on-write suits read-heavy tables that change rarely.

risk_directions.label: Set to copy-on-write
risk_directions.detail: Each row-level commit rewrites every data file it touches. Frequent small updates become expensive and slow.

risk_directions.label: Reset to default
risk_directions.detail: Each row-level commit rewrites every data file it touches. Frequent small updates become expensive and slow.

engine_notes.note: Read by Spark DELETE.
Trino always writes position deletes (deletion vectors on v3) regardless.

settings.label: UPDATE mode
settings.summary: copy-on-write rewrites every data file an UPDATE touches; merge-on-read writes delete files plus new rows.
settings.takes_effect: The next UPDATE statement.
settings.reversible: Yes. A metadata-only commit; set it back at any time.
settings.note: No recommendation: merge-on-read suits frequent small updates, copy-on-write suits read-heavy tables that change rarely.

risk_directions.label: Set to copy-on-write
risk_directions.detail: Each row-level commit rewrites every data file it touches. Frequent small updates become expensive and slow.

risk_directions.label: Reset to default
risk_directions.detail: Each row-level commit rewrites every data file it touches. Frequent small updates become expensive and slow.

engine_notes.note: Read by Spark UPDATE.
Not read; Trino uses merge-on-read semantics.

settings.label: MERGE mode
settings.summary: copy-on-write rewrites every data file a MERGE touches; merge-on-read writes delete files plus new rows.
settings.takes_effect: The next MERGE statement.
settings.reversible: Yes. A metadata-only commit; set it back at any time.
settings.note: No recommendation: merge-on-read suits frequent small updates, copy-on-write suits read-heavy tables that change rarely.

risk_directions.label: Set to merge-on-read
risk_directions.detail: Each row-level commit adds delete files that every read must apply until rewrite_position_deletes or convert_deletes folds them in. Make sure the preset runs delete compaction.

engine_notes.note: Read by Spark MERGE INTO.
Not read; Trino uses merge-on-read semantics.

settings.label: Position delete granularity
settings.summary: Whether a merge-on-read commit writes one position-delete file per partition or per data file. file-scoped deletes are read only with their data file and are dropped when that file is compacted.
settings.takes_effect: The next merge-on-read commit.
settings.reversible: Yes. A metadata-only commit; set it back at any time.
settings.recommendation_reason: This table writes merge-on-read deletes. File-scoped deletes are read only with their data file and disappear when that file is compacted.

engine_notes.note: Spark's delete-granularity write option defaults to file and overrides this.
Format v3 tables use deletion vectors, which are always per data file.

settings.label: Upsert writes
settings.summary: Makes every write an upsert keyed on the identifier fields: the old row is removed with an equality delete and the new row appended.
settings.takes_effect: The next write from an engine that honours it.
settings.reversible: Yes. A metadata-only commit; set it back at any time.

risk_directions.label: Turn on
risk_directions.detail: Every write produces equality deletes, which slow reads until compacted.

engine_notes.note: Read by Flink for batch and streaming writes. Requires format v2+ and identifier fields.
Not read by Spark.
Not read by Trino.

settings.label: Commit retries
settings.summary: How many times a writer retries a commit that lost an optimistic-concurrency race before failing.
settings.takes_effect: The next commit from any writer.
settings.reversible: Yes. A metadata-only commit; set it back at any time.

risk_directions.label: Lower
risk_directions.detail: Any concurrent commit, including Cryo's compaction, fails the write outright.

engine_notes.note: Trino table property max_commit_retry (470+).

settings.label: Commit retry minimum wait
settings.summary: Initial backoff before the first commit retry.
settings.takes_effect: The next commit from any writer.
settings.reversible: Yes. A metadata-only commit; set it back at any time.

settings.label: Commit retry maximum wait
settings.summary: Upper bound on the exponential backoff between commit retries.
settings.takes_effect: The next commit from any writer.
settings.reversible: Yes. A metadata-only commit; set it back at any time.

settings.label: Commit retry total timeout
settings.summary: Total time a writer keeps retrying a commit before giving up.
settings.takes_effect: The next commit from any writer.
settings.reversible: Yes. A metadata-only commit; set it back at any time.

settings.label: Merge manifests on commit
settings.summary: Lets merge-append commits fold small manifests together. Off means every append adds a manifest, which slows query planning until manifests are rewritten.
settings.takes_effect: The next append commit.
settings.reversible: Yes. A metadata-only commit; set it back at any time.
settings.recommendation_reason: With merging off, every append adds a manifest and query planning slows down.

risk_directions.label: Turn off
risk_directions.detail: Every append adds a manifest; planning slows until optimize_manifests runs.

engine_notes.note: Spark streaming uses fast appends, which never merge, unless use-merge-append-for-streaming is set.

settings.label: Target manifest size
settings.summary: Target size of manifest files produced by commits and manifest rewrites.
settings.takes_effect: The next commit and the next manifest rewrite.
settings.reversible: Yes. A metadata-only commit; set it back at any time.

engine_notes.note: Controls the output of optimize_manifests.
Controls the output of rewrite_manifests.

settings.label: Manifests before merge
settings.summary: Minimum number of manifests to accumulate before a merge-append merges them.
settings.takes_effect: The next append commit.
settings.reversible: Yes. A metadata-only commit; set it back at any time.

settings.label: Delete old metadata files
settings.summary: After each commit, delete the oldest tracked metadata.json beyond the previous-versions limit. Without it, metadata files accumulate on storage.
settings.takes_effect: The next commit. Files that already fell off the metadata log are not touched; only orphan-file removal reclaims those.
settings.reversible: The setting is reversible; metadata files deleted while it was on are gone.

risk_directions.label: Turn on
risk_directions.detail: Writers start deleting metadata.json files beyond the newest 100. Those files cannot be restored.

engine_notes.note: Trino table property delete_after_commit_enabled (480+).

settings.label: Metadata versions kept
settings.summary: How many previous metadata.json files the metadata log tracks. With delete-after-commit on, older ones are deleted.
settings.takes_effect: The next commit.
settings.reversible: Yes. A metadata-only commit; set it back at any time.

engine_notes.note: Trino table property max_previous_versions (480+).

settings.label: Column metrics
settings.summary: Which per-column statistics go into manifests. truncate(N) and full keep min/max bounds that let engines skip files; counts and none do not.
settings.takes_effect: Files written from now on. Existing files keep their stored metrics.
settings.reversible: Yes. A metadata-only commit; set it back at any time.

risk_directions.label: Set to none
risk_directions.detail: New files lose min/max bounds, so engines can no longer skip them by filter.

risk_directions.label: Set to counts
risk_directions.detail: New files lose min/max bounds, so engines can no longer skip them by filter.

risk_directions.label: Set to full
risk_directions.detail: Full bounds on long strings make manifests larger.

settings.label: Columns with default metrics
settings.summary: Only the first N columns get the default metrics mode. Filters on later columns cannot prune files by min/max.
settings.takes_effect: Files written from now on.
settings.reversible: Yes. A metadata-only commit; set it back at any time.

risk_directions.label: Lower
risk_directions.detail: Columns after the first 1 of 14 get no min/max statistics.

settings.label: Garbage collection
settings.summary: Whether snapshot expiry and orphan-file removal may delete this table's files. Owners turn it off when another table shares these files.
settings.takes_effect: The next expiry or orphan-removal run.
settings.reversible: Yes. A metadata-only commit; set it back at any time.

risk_directions.label: Turn off
risk_directions.detail: Cryo stops expiring snapshots and removing orphan files here, so storage only grows. Trino before 484 ignores this flag if someone runs those procedures directly.

engine_notes.note: Enforced from Trino 484 (gc_enabled). Earlier Trino deletes files regardless.
expire_snapshots and remove_orphan_files refuse to run.
iceberg-go expiry refuses to run.
Cryo skips expire_snapshots and remove_orphan_files while this is false.

settings.label: Snapshot age limit (table)
settings.summary: Default age after which snapshots may be expired, for the table and every branch without its own limit.
settings.takes_effect: The next snapshot expiry that does not pass an explicit age.
settings.reversible: The setting is reversible; snapshots expired under it are gone.
settings.note: Cryo passes its own retention to every engine; this applies to expiry run elsewhere.

risk_directions.label: Lower
risk_directions.detail: Lowering snapshot age limit (table) lets the next run delete history that is kept today. Deleted snapshots and files cannot be recovered.

engine_notes.note: Cryo passes its own retention to every engine, so this only affects expiry run outside Cryo.
Default older_than for expire_snapshots.
Ignored; Trino's retention_threshold defaults to 7 days.
Default for iceberg-go expiry.

settings.label: Snapshots always kept (table)
settings.summary: Expiry never removes the most recent N ancestors of each branch.
settings.takes_effect: The next snapshot expiry that does not pass an explicit count.
settings.reversible: The setting is reversible; snapshots expired under it are gone.
settings.note: Cryo passes its own retention to every engine; this applies to expiry run elsewhere.

engine_notes.note: Cryo passes retain_last explicitly, so this only affects expiry run outside Cryo.
Default retain_last for expire_snapshots.

settings.label: Branch and tag age limit
settings.summary: Age after which non-main branches and tags are removed by expiry. Unset means they live forever and keep every snapshot they point to.
settings.takes_effect: The next snapshot expiry.
settings.reversible: The setting is reversible; branches and tags removed under it are gone.
settings.note: 1 branch(es)/tag(s) (q3-close) never expire and keep their snapshots' files alive.

risk_directions.label: Set a limit
risk_directions.detail: Branches and tags without their own limit are removed once older than this, and the snapshots only they kept are expired. Affects: q3-close.

settings.label: Cryo snapshot retention
settings.summary: Snapshots older than this are expired when Cryo runs expire_snapshots.
settings.takes_effect: Cryo's next expire_snapshots run on this table.
settings.reversible: The override is reversible; snapshots expired under it are gone.

risk_directions.label: Lower
risk_directions.detail: Lowering cryo snapshot retention lets the next run delete history that is kept today. Deleted snapshots and files cannot be recovered.

engine_notes.note: The planner shortens this to 1 to 3 days for streaming or snapshot-backlogged tables.
Trino rejects values below iceberg.expire-snapshots.min-retention (7d default).

settings.label: Cryo snapshots always kept
settings.summary: Cryo's expire_snapshots always keeps at least this many recent snapshots.
settings.takes_effect: Cryo's next expire_snapshots run on this table.
settings.reversible: The override is reversible; snapshots expired under it are gone.

settings.label: Cryo orphan-file age
settings.summary: remove_orphan_files only deletes unreferenced files older than this. It must exceed the longest write, or in-flight files are deleted.
settings.takes_effect: Cryo's next remove_orphan_files run on this table.
settings.reversible: The override is reversible; files deleted under it are gone.

risk_directions.label: Lower
risk_directions.detail: Lowering cryo orphan-file age lets the next run delete history that is kept today. Deleted snapshots and files cannot be recovered.

engine_notes.note: Trino rejects values below iceberg.remove-orphan-files.min-retention (7d default).
Spark's own default is 3 days.
iceberg-go's own default is 72 hours.

settings.label: Format version
settings.summary: Iceberg table format. v2 adds row-level deletes; v3 adds deletion vectors, row lineage, default values and new types.
settings.takes_effect: Immediately for every reader and writer.
settings.reversible: No. Format upgrades are one-way; there is no downgrade.
settings.note: v3 adds deletion vectors and row lineage; Trino's v3 support is still experimental.

risk_directions.label: Upgrade to v3
risk_directions.detail: Upgrading to v3 is permanent. Every engine that reads or writes this table must support v3 first.
risk_directions.blocked: Cryo writes table metadata with PyIceberg, which upgrades only to v2. Upgrade to v3 with Spark (ALTER TABLE … SET TBLPROPERTIES ('format-version'='3')) or Trino (ALTER TABLE … SET PROPERTIES format_version = 3).

engine_notes.note: v3 support is experimental; add_files is not supported on v3.
Every reader and writer needs Iceberg 1.8+ (1.9+ for row lineage).

settings.label: Table description
settings.summary: Free-text description shown by engines and catalogs.
settings.takes_effect: Immediately.
settings.reversible: Yes. A metadata-only commit; set it back at any time.

changes.label: Snapshot age limit (table)
warnings: Lowering snapshot age limit (table) lets the next run delete history that is kept today. Deleted snapshots and files cannot be recovered.
